title: Convert the Temperature
sourceKind: search-snippets-only (official page returns 403 to WebFetch; statement taken from search-result summaries of secondary sites)
summary: Given celsius, return [kelvin, fahrenheit] where kelvin = celsius + 273.15 and fahrenheit = celsius * 1.80 + 32.00. Answers within 1e-5 are accepted.
officialConstraints: Secondary summaries: celsius from 0 to 1000 with two decimals (not confirmed on the official page).
visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts celsius 0 to 1000 with at most two decimals. Examples 36.50 -> [309.65, 97.70] and 122.11 -> [395.26, 251.798] come from a search summary; not confirmed on the official page.
